steps.name: project-setup
steps.summary: Scaffolded pyproject.toml (uv), gateway/ + mocks/ + tests/ package skeleton, deploy/schema.sql (7 tables per TRD §4.1), config.yaml + gateway/config/loader.py (Pydantic + watchfiles hot reload), gateway/db.py (asyncpg pool), gateway/main.py (FastAPI app with /healthz), root Dockerfile, and deploy/docker-compose.yml (gateway, redis, postgres, mock-openai, mock-anthropic).

steps.name: canonical-schema
steps.summary: Added gateway/schemas.py — canonical OpenAI-compatible Pydantic models (ChatMessage, ChatCompletionRequest, Usage, ChatCompletionChoice, ChatCompletionResponse, ChatCompletionChunkDelta, ChatCompletionChunkChoice, ChatCompletionChunk) for provider adapters and gateway routing to import.

steps.name: mock-providers
steps.summary: Added mocks/fault_injection.py (stateless X-Mock-Fault header / --fault-<type> model-suffix trigger for timeout|error|rate_limit, ADR-025), mocks/mock_openai/app.py (POST /v1/chat/completions on port 8081, OpenAI-shaped non-streaming/SSE responses, word-count-based fabricated usage), mocks/mock_anthropic/app.py (POST /v1/messages on port 8082, Anthropic-native message/event-stream shape, untranslated), mocks/Dockerfile.openai + Dockerfile.anthropic wired into the existing compose stubs, and tests/test_mocks.py.
